speculative: DSpark (method dspark, built into checkpoint), num_speculative_tokens 5, probabilistic draft sampling

measured.concurrency_notes: No numbers in this repo. Upstream recipe README reports 0731+Patch4 mean 55.4 / peak 66.1 tok/s (different image/runtime).

extra_setup: start.sh clones tonyd2wild recipe (unpinned HEAD) and runs its docker compose (project deepseek-v4-flash) on both nodes, worker (NODE_RANK=1, HEADLESS=1) first. Pulls ghcr image, tags vllm-026-gb10-dsv4-dspark:latest, docker save/scp/load to worker. Downloads deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 on head via snapshot_download and rsyncs blobs to worker HF cache. Auto-detects RoCE HCA/iface/GID per node. Passwordless SSH head->worker (zurih@10.0.0.2).
notes: Args/env are the upstream compose at the commit current when this repo was last updated (2026-07-31), with this repo's .env overrides (MAX_MODEL_LEN 327680, MAX_NUM_SEQS 16, MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS 16384, GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION 0.835, MTP 5, VLLM_HOST 0.0.0.0). Recipe is cloned unpinned, so the compose changes over time (later upstream adds node-local /vllm-cache JIT mount, KV_CACHE_DTYPE override, drops --max-cudagraph-capture-size). --max-cudagraph-capture-size is $(( MAX_NUM_SEQS * (MTP_NUM_TOKENS + 1) )) = 96. MISMATCH: start.sh downloads deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 but never sets DSPARK_MODEL, so the served path falls back to the .env example value deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark (upstream preview checkpoint is fraserprice/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark); set DSPARK_MODEL to the 0731 path. MOE_BACKEND=flashinfer_b12x, OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL=2, PERFORMANCE_MODE=balanced are written to .env but not consumed by the compose. GLOO/TP_SOCKET_IFNAME exported on host do not reach the container at that compose revision. Weights: official DeepSeek checkpoint (config.json quant_method fp8 e4m3, 128x128 blocks, ue8m0 scales; MoE runs on the b12x MXFP4 backend), KV cache nvfp4_ds_mla; README calls it NVFP4. Runtime is vLLM 0.26 (r0b0tlab image); Patch 4 skipped for v0.26 images. Head VLLM_HOST_IP 10.0.0.1, worker 10.0.0.2.
